description: This file defines the interface for managing Git worktrees, including structures, function prototypes for retrieving, validating, repairing, and managing worktrees within a Git repository.

classes.name: worktree
classes.description: Struct representing a Git worktree with details such as path, repository, head reference, and state flags.

methods.name: get_worktrees
methods.description: Retrieve all worktrees associated with the repository, with the primary worktree first.

methods.name: get_worktrees_without_reading_head
methods.description: Retrieve worktrees without reading their HEAD references, useful for inconsistent refdb states.

methods.name: submodule_uses_worktrees
methods.description: Check if linked submodules use worktrees at the specified path.

methods.name: get_worktree_git_dir
methods.description: Get the Git directory of a specified worktree.

methods.name: find_worktree
methods.description: Find a worktree based on user-supplied identifier, such as pathname or shorthand.

methods.name: get_linked_worktree
methods.description: Get the linked worktree associated with a specific ID, optionally skipping HEAD reading.

methods.name: find_worktree_by_path
methods.description: Find a worktree by its file system path.

methods.name: is_main_worktree
methods.description: Determine if a worktree is the main one.

methods.name: worktree_lock_reason
methods.description: Retrieve the reason why a worktree is locked, if applicable.

methods.name: worktree_prune_reason
methods.description: Get the reason why a worktree should be pruned, considering expiry.

methods.name: should_prune_worktree
methods.description: Decide if a worktree should be pruned, returning reason and path.

methods.name: validate_worktree
methods.description: Validate the integrity of a worktree, returning success or error message.

methods.name: update_worktree_location
methods.description: Update the file system location of a worktree.

methods.name: repair_worktrees
methods.description: Visit and repair linked worktrees, using a callback for progress and errors.

methods.name: repair_worktrees_after_gitdir_move
methods.description: Repair all linked worktrees after moving the main git directory.

methods.name: repair_worktree_after_gitdir_move
methods.description: Repair a specific worktree after its gitdir has been moved.

methods.name: repair_worktree_at_path
methods.description: Repair the administrative files of a worktree at a specific path.

methods.name: free_worktree
methods.description: Free the memory associated with a single worktree.

methods.name: free_worktrees
methods.description: Free memory for multiple worktrees.

methods.name: find_shared_symref
methods.description: Find a worktree that shares a symbolic ref with a given symbol.

methods.name: is_shared_symref
methods.description: Check if a symref points to a ref in any worktree.

methods.name: other_head_refs
methods.description: Execute a callback for each HEAD reference in all but the current worktree.

methods.name: is_worktree_being_rebased
methods.description: Check if a worktree is currently rebasing.

methods.name: is_worktree_being_bisected
methods.description: Check if a worktree is involved in bisecting.

methods.name: strbuf_worktree_ref
methods.description: Generate a refname string for a worktree.

methods.name: init_worktree_config
methods.description: Initialize configuration for a worktree, making necessary adjustments.

methods.name: write_worktree_linking_files
methods.description: Write the files linking a worktree to its repository, such as .git and gitdir files.

ctags.name: head_ref
ctags.pattern: /^	char *head_ref;		\/* NULL if HEAD is broken or detached *\/$/

ctags.name: worktree_repair_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(int iserr,const char * path,const char * msg,void * cb_data)
